candidate_evidence.quote: [DIAGNOSTIC_TEST] Multimodal Blood Brain Barrier Assessment: A standardised multimodal diagnostic assessment designed to characterize blood brain barrier integrity in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: High-resolution 3-Tesla MRI with and without gadolinium contrast, including structural and functional imaging sequences.

agents.drug_class_hint: gadolinium-based MRI contrast agent, product not named

biomarkers.biomarker_other: BBB-associated protein expression (IHC) and transcriptional signatures in resected tumour tissue

source_quote.quote: Expression of blood-brain barrier-associated proteins within resected glioblastoma tissue assessed by immunohistochemical analysis.

coder_notes: Observational-style diagnostic study (phase NA) of BBB disruption; no therapeutic agent. 'Glioblastoma multiforme' in brief summary -> cns5_terminology historical. Gadolinium contrast is part of the registered multimodal assessment every participant undergoes, listed as diagnostic_agent (product unnamed); could be omitted under R9 if considered routine imaging. Fluorescein appears only in the title with no stated administration, so not listed. Serum BBB/neuronal-injury markers (S100B, GFAP, UCHL1, amyloid beta, p-tau, NSE) are not tumour molecular biomarkers and are not recorded.
